From our door, it is a 10-minute walk to Hoan Kiem Lake, 10 minutes to the Temple of Literature, 2 minutes to the Train Street cafés, and about 1 km to the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. We are open 24/7 and offer an on-site restaurant for your convenience. We stayed with Ha Noi Calido hotel in Old Quarter area for 5 days (5-10 Sep) . Trust you me , we never felt that we are in a hotel rather from day 1 we felt this is our second home in Hanoi. Starting from the owners to the staff everyone was welcoming , helpful and informative. Our encyclopedia were each and every team member at the front desk. Mr. Bank , Ms, Lily , Ms. Trixie were extremely helpful and smiling . On the day of our arrival we had arranged the pick up from the hotel and when we arrived , the staff was standing at the main door to welcome us. It took us hardly 5 minutes to finish our checking formalities and go to the room. Likewise we were given a warm sendoff by the staff . The rooms are equipped with Tea/ Coffee maker, Small fridge, Work Desk with chair, Open wardrobe . Rooms have separate glass cubicles for toilet and shower. Basic amenities like toothbrush, Shaving kit, Comb, Shoer cap , Body wash and shampoo. Water is provided and replenished everyday . To maintain your privacy, they have door tags which you can hang them if you wish to get the housekeeping done in your room or maintain privacy. Don't forget to see the big aquarium on the right side of the hotel entrance . They lobby has some artifacts and temple . Sightseeing places are walking distance specially the train street which is just 3 minutes walk . The Water puppet show theatre , Night Market , The King Roti are hardly 10 minutes by walk . I saw the owners personally taking care of the guests during breakfast . All due respect to the lady owner who i saw even picked the used dishes and cleaned the tables for the guests . This is what is called customer service. Breakfast has Noodles, Fried rice, Fresh fries, salad, cut fruits, breads, pan cake with chocolate sauce , tea , coffee , Milk and juice. Highly Highly Highly recommended place to stay . Love you guys at Hotel Ha Noi Calido and all my respect for the owners .
